newsitem.title: USA: Ancor Communications in $1.0 mln pact.
newsitem.headline: Ancor Communications in $1.0 mln pact.

text.p: Ancor Communications Inc said Wednesday it signed a $1 million agreement with Integration Systems Pty Ltd, an Australian distributor of high-performance computer and network products.
Under the agreement, Integration will sell Ancor Fibre Channel networking products in Sydney and New South Wales.

"The Sydney-New South Wales region includes a concentration of financial, engineering and manufacturing companies that are ideal targets for our gigabit-speed network solutions," Stephen O'Hara, Ancor president, said in a statement. "Combined with our strong distributor base in Singapore and Japan, we believe Integration Systems positions us to even more effectively deepen our market penetration in this part of the world."

Separately, Ancor Communications said it launched its GigWorks line of gigabit-speed network products. The company said it introduced a new high-performance Fibre Channel PCI product for Silicon Graphics Inc's Origin series and the Apple Computer Inc Macintosh.
